pool_skew_critical_minors.description: Check 3.2: a node pool this many minors or more behind its control plane is critical. GKE's documented skew ceiling is two, so the shipped default flags the first version past it.

fleet_spread_min_minors.description: Check 3.3: emit the fleet-spread finding when the newest and oldest control-plane minors differ by at least this many.

blocking_exclusion_min_days.description: Check 3.8: an upgrade-blocking maintenance exclusion that ends further out than this many days is flagged even on a cluster with no outstanding version finding.

deprecated_image_types.description: Check 3.9: node image types flagged as deprecated regardless of whether the location still offers them. Compared case-insensitively.

excluded_clusters.description: Cluster names this audit leaves out of scope entirely. Each is recorded in scope.skipped with the reason 'excluded by criteria' so the ledger says the omission was chosen.
